{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Maybe, if we fight hard and smart enough, slow it down to the point that we could contact the Alliance communications ship that's in orbit near Sullust, and get some kind of operational task force ordered out here.|[[Gennad Rozhdenst]]|<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>}}
A '''communications ship''' was a naval vessel fitted with transceivers to facilitate communication between various fleet elements and military headquarters.

==History==
Comm ships were used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to both aid friendly forces and hinder enemies. The latter was accomplished through jamming measures that scrambled the enemy's lines of communication.

In the time of the Empire, several communications ships were among the support vessels kept in readiness by individual [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] and [[Oversector/Legends|Oversector]] navy worlds.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
